content: Inter-annotator agreement (Cohen's kappa >=0.60 typical bar, Krippendorff's alpha, Fleiss' kappa, PABAK for skewed distributions) is standard for multi-annotator human labeling teams or human-vs-LLM validation studies; not standard practice for single-human-reviewer pipelines with one ground truth source (no second annotator to compare against) — recommend simple accept/reject/edit tracking instead of formal agreement stats for single-maintainer scale.
